headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises SageOne on acquisition by ASK Asset Management

detail: ASK Asset Management Private Limited, a Blackstone-backed asset management platform, has acquired 100% of the shareholding of SageOne Investment Managers LLP. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised SageOne Investment Managers LLP, its founder Mr. Samit Vartak, SageOne Ventures LLP and the sellers, advising on all aspects of the transaction, including the negotiation and finalisation of the acquisition agreement, the agreement with ASK Investment Managers Limited and other transaction documents. The transaction team comprised Jay Gandhi (Partner), Abhishek Parekh (Partner), Namrata Bhagwatula (Partner), Nayanikaa Shukla (Senior Associate), Awantika Yash (Associate) and Aayush Bafna…
